title: Zesty Buttery Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A buttery and creamy Spanish dish featuring bacon lardon and coconut cream, perfect for a high protein meal. This recipe is made in a kadhai vessel.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large kadhai over medium heat.
Add the bacon lardon and cook until crispy, then remove from the kadhai and set aside.
Add the chicken to the kadhai and cook until browned, then remove from the kadhai and set aside with the bacon.
Add the smoked paprika and saffron threads to the kadhai and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked white rice to the kadhai and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the kadhai and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the kadhai, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the coconut cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the chicken and bacon to the kadhai and cook until heated through.
